versions.content: If PduR_DoIPTpStartOfReception returns BUFREQ_E_OVFL, the DoIP module shall send a diagnostic negative acknowledge message with the di- agnostic message negative acknowledge code set to 0x05 and discard all the TCP data until the next DoIP message.
